en-US.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the Avid Pro Tools workflow in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
SoundCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the Avid Pro Tools workflow, rebuilt in pure Rust. An Edit window for arranging and editing, a Mix window for balancing, edit modes, tools, playlists, memory locations and AudioSuite processing: if you have spent years in that workflow, your hands should already know where things are.

- Editing: Shuffle, Slip, Spot and Grid modes; Smart, Selector, Grabber, Trim, Pencil, Zoom and Scrubber tools; clip edits, fades and crossfades in five shapes, playlists with comping lanes, clip gain lines, edit groups and single-key Commands Focus shortcuts.
- Mixing: ten inserts and ten sends per track, busses and aux inputs, master faders, VCAs, routing folders, solo modes, phase invert and trim, clip effects and automatic plugin delay compensation.
- Automation: breakpoint automation for volume, pan, mute, sends and every plugin parameter, recorded live in Write, Touch and Latch, with thin, glide, coalesce and convert to clip gain.
- Plugins: original EQ, compressor/limiter, reverbs, modulation, saturation, pitch and synth plugins; CLAP, VST3 and Audio Units load with their own editors; any processor runs offline as AudioSuite.
- MIDI: instrument tracks with built-in synths, a piano-roll editor with a velocity lane, step input, quantize, Standard MIDI File import and export, Audio-to-MIDI, and a Score Editor with MusicXML export.
- Video and surround: a picture track decoding H.264, ProRes and Motion JPEG in pure Rust, and main and bus formats from stereo to 9.1.6 and Ambisonics with a Renderer window.
- Files and bounce: WAV/BWF/RF64, AIFF/AIFC and FLAC in and out; MP3, Ogg Vorbis, AAC, ALAC, CAF and movie audio in; mix or stems to WAV, AIFF or FLAC with peak, true peak and LUFS reporting.
en-US.name: SoundCraft

zh-CN.description: 一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 Avid Pro Tools 的工作流
zh-CN.longDescription:
SoundCraft 是一个用纯 Rust 全新重写的开源净室实现，还原了 Avid Pro Tools 的工作流：用于排布和剪辑的 Edit 窗口、用于平衡的 Mix 窗口，以及编辑模式、工具、播放列表、记忆位置和 AudioSuite 处理。如果你在这个工作流里浸润多年，双手会自然而然找到位置。

- 剪辑：Shuffle、Slip、Spot、Grid 四种模式；Smart、Selector、Grabber、Trim、Pencil、Zoom、Scrubber 工具；剪辑操作、五种形状的淡入淡出与交叉淡化、带 comping 轨道的播放列表、剪辑增益线、编辑组和单键 Commands Focus 快捷键。
- 混音：每条轨道十个插入位和十个发送位，总线和辅助输入，主输出推子、VCA、路由文件夹、独奏模式、相位反转与微调、剪辑特效和自动插件延迟补偿。
- 自动化：音量、声像、静音、发送和每个插件参数的断点自动化，可从推子实时录制 Write、Touch、Latch，支持抽稀、滑移、合并和转换为剪辑增益。
- 插件：原创的 EQ、压缩器/限制器、混响、调制、饱和、音高和合成器插件；支持加载 CLAP、VST3 和 Audio Units 并使用其自带编辑器；任何处理器都可通过 AudioSuite 离线运行。
- MIDI：带内置合成器的乐器轨道、带力度窗格的钢琴卷帘编辑器、步进输入、量化、Standard MIDI File 导入导出、Audio-to-MIDI，以及可导出 MusicXML 的乐谱编辑器。
- 视频与环绕声：图片轨道可用纯 Rust 解码 H.264、ProRes 和 Motion JPEG；主输出和总线格式从立体声到 9.1.6 和 Ambisonics，并有 Renderer 窗口。
- 文件与导出：WAV/BWF/RF64、AIFF/AIFC 和 FLAC 输入输出；MP3、Ogg Vorbis、AAC、ALAC、CAF 和影片音频导入；可混音或分轨导出为 WAV、AIFF 或 FLAC，并报告峰值、真峰值和 LUFS 响度。
